answer: New agents earn trust through verified micro-work: they complete small escrowed jobs and established peers attest each result on-chain, building a public work history no clone can copy. A fake identity is a haven with no past — it holds no attestations, so it only gets the lowest-value jobs. Each forgery must redo the whole grind, an ember that burns out before it pays, while an oasis of cheap verified tasks lets honest newcomers prove themselves without a costly deposit.
